import unittest
from copy import deepcopy
from solution import assemble_sections


class AssembleSectionsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_last_value_wins_without_moving_first_position(self):
        pairs = [
            ("alpha", {"version": 1}),
            ("beta", {"enabled": True}),
            ("alpha", {"version": 2}),
            ("gamma", {}),
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            assemble_sections(pairs),
            {"alpha": {"version": 2}, "beta": {"enabled": True}, "gamma": {}},
        )
        self.assertEqual(list(assemble_sections(pairs)), ["alpha", "beta", "gamma"])

    def test_deep_copy_and_non_mutation(self):
        options = {"nested": {"values": [1]}}
        pairs = [("section", options)]
        snapshot = deepcopy(pairs)
        result = assemble_sections(pairs)
        self.assertEqual(pairs, snapshot)
        self.assertIsNot(result["section"], options)
        self.assertIsNot(result["section"]["nested"], options["nested"])
        result["section"]["nested"]["values"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(options["nested"]["values"], [1])
        options["nested"]["values"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(result["section"]["nested"]["values"], [1, 2])

    def test_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual(assemble_sections([]), {})

    def test_malformed_inputs(self):
        for value in (None, (), "x"):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    assemble_sections(value)
        for pair in (["name", {}], ("name",), ("name", {}, 3), (3, {}), ("name", [])):
            with self.subTest(pair=pair):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    assemble_sections([pair])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            assemble_sections([("", {})])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
